notes.title: Onwards
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hey and hello![/b][/h3][p]Guess what - Crystals Of Irm is part of this year's “No Time to Loot” festival - woo-hoo! Feel free to check it out - there are lots of great games there.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/5658b60efd37de23d412a3fa95cc73beb1306df0.png"][/img][/p][p]Today's update will be a little shorter than usual because I've got my hands full right now. But despite all the tasks I have to do, I'm making good progress and the game is coming along nicely again.[/p][h3][b]Weekly Task[/b][/h3][p]As discussed last week, the new internal version is ready and I'm waiting for feedback on it. The newly implemented dialogue system and my cutscene system work wonderfully together and give me the opportunity to communicate the motivation or necessity of various quests much better! The demo update will give you a first little taste of this![/p][h3][b]Demo Stuff[/b][/h3][p]I'm currently in the final stages of completing the demo update. As already mentioned, some of the bugs you reported will be fixed, and Miris will be expanded to include the Adventurers' Guild. Here, you can accept quests that will take you to the labyrinth dungeons in Irm and also interact with other adventurers. I'm excited to hear what you think![/p][p]So that's it for this week's dev update! See you again next week.[/p][p]Until then,[/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p]

notes.title: Community
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey and Hallo![/b][/p][p]First of all, sorry for the delay this week! [/p][p]But now we're finally ready with this week's update! Now that Gamescom is over, I'm continuing my work on Crystals. What has become even clearer to me in recent weeks, and was really evident with the release of the demo, is how important your feedback and your voice are in the process. [/p][p]That's why, in addition to the feedback tool, which you can use directly from the demo and which is already being used extensively, I've expanded the Discord channel in this direction. You now have the option to send me feedback and bug reports directly from there. You can also contribute ideas, which the community can then vote on directly. If enough votes are cast for an idea, I will be notified and can discuss it with you directly. [/p][p]At this point, I would like to say a big thank you to all of you. Your input, whether on Discord or via the feedback tool, is incredibly helpful! I would also like to take this opportunity to thank you for the kind tone in which you communicate with me! [/p][p]You are amazing![/p][h3][b]Weekly Task[/b][/h3][p]This week, I'm working on a new internal version in which I'm focusing on the game's start. More on that soon, once I'm done with testing and everything is the way I want it to be! But I think it's going to be really good.[/p][h3][b]Demo Stuff[/b][/h3][p]The new start of the game mentioned above will also affect the content of the demo. More on that when everything is ready. The next update will also fix a whole bunch of bugs that you've brought to my attention![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/8f9da0adf26bd708a1f009e0114fe83c3206d0eb.png"][/img][/p][p]And that's it for this week's dev update. If you have any feedback, want to report a bug, or just want to chat with the community, come join us on [url="https://www.discord.com/invite/JeXVRWz"]Discord Of Irm[/url].[/p][p]See you next week![/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p]

notes.title: New Chapter
notes.notes: [h2]Hey and Hallo![/h2][p]Something fundamental has changed this week - I've made it and am now working full-time on Crystals Of Irm. It's been a wild ride to get here, and I'm really excited about this new chapter. It will also be really good for the game that I can now invest much more time in its development. A big thank you to everyone who has been with me this far.[/p][p]At this point, I would also like to say a big thank you to everyone who uses the feedback tool in the demo and shares their ideas with me, reports bugs, and actively helps me make the game better! Thank you! [/p][p]I have also decided to structure these weekly posts a little better. The idea is to use the beginning for general information - what's going on with me, what's happening, etc.[/p][p]This will be followed by a section on what I'll be working on during the week and finally a short section on planned demo updates. [/p][h3]Weekly Task[/h3][p]This week, the start of the full version will undergo another overhaul. The goal is to make the introduction to the combat system a little more relaxed and to introduce the story in an understandable way. It's going to be really good![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/ae37d019685859fd6bb503bf055d1835b06a4570.png"][/img][/p][h3]Demo Stuff[/h3][p]In the next demo update, we're saying goodbye to the input billboards that always seemed a bit out of place around the corresponding interactions and welcoming a dynamic cursor that is located in the center of the screen and indicates the corresponding interaction - it's about time![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="MELyZdC2QnM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]That's it for this week's update! If you have any questions or want to chat with me about the game, feel free to join the Discord Of Irm! Or if you want to give direct feedback on the game, check out the demo and use the feedback tool.[/p][p]See you next week![/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p]

notes.title: Gamescom roundup & What's Next
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hey and Hallo![/b] [/h3][p]Gamescom is over, I'm back home, and what can I say - it was simply amazing! A huge thank you to everyone who stopped by the booth for all the kind words and great feedback. It was truly wonderful to meet you all!  [/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/08a981cd87de6dcf5ebe60a8f66bd1f028035b8b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/5f6efba860798148fa222833578cae77677349cb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/8e2e1d202ae76a20ac4c84498f479e52778067d6.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]Since I'm working on this game mostly on my own, it was really great to see that you enjoy Crystals Of Irm! The best part, though, was having the opportunity to talk to you a bit about your experiences. That was incredibly valuable, and I learned a lot.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/7ed94644db80f83a661270422c4838e6daedb1b0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The demo will remain online from now on and will be updated with new features and bug fixes. In addition, the feedback tool will remain active, allowing you to send me direct feedback or bug reports. This means that even after Gamescom, you can continue to explore Crystals Of Irm and actively participate in its development. This way, I want to stay in touch with you and discuss your feedback. In addition to the feedback tool in the demo, you can also come directly to [url="https://discord.gg/zYxNSK7a2n"]Discord [/url]and exchange ideas with me and others there! Your feedback and impressions are really helpful to me -and since I'm working on the game as a solo developer, they're one of the most important factors in making the game great![/p][p]For me, it's now straight back to work on Crystals Of Irm - I want to get the new update finished this week.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2209040/Crystals_Of_Irm_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Take care![/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Indie Arena Booth & Gamescom
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey and Hallo![/b] [/p][p]The new week has begun and it's getting serious! [b]Gamescom[/b] is coming up and you can play Crystals Of Irm in the [b]Indie Arena Booth[/b]! I'll be there on Wednesday to answer your questions! Come and visit Irm! I'm really looking forward to it! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/7c46a0d5a3cdc20d1a7b492246f69deab6a12e83.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Also, the demo has received an update and the first wave of feedback I received has been directly implemented. I hope that the game experience is now even more enjoyable for you. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/865d74d0c9dfa1757c46f77a4a858bcfce6b9e29.png"][/img][/p][p]With the update, a feedback tool has made it into the game that allows you to send feedback and bug reports directly from the game to me. Feel free to use it and send me your feedback. The tool can be called up in the game via F12, where you can fill out a small form, specify whether it is general feedback or a bug and send the whole thing.[/p][p]That concludes the Dev Update for the week - there's a lot going on and I can't wait to get to Cologne! Maybe I'll see you at the booth - I'm looking forward to it.[/p][p]From next week it will finally be a bit quieter and the dev updates will be a bit more extensive again. [/p][p]Take care[/p][p]David[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to Miris
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey and hello![/b][/p][p]I would like to start with a big thank you! Thank you so much for playing the demo in such large numbers, and I really hope you enjoyed it. In the meantime, I have heard about a few bugs, and they will be updated in the middle of the week. Participating in the Tiny Teams Festival is a huge success for Crystals Of Irm and I am incredibly grateful that my game can be part of it.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/6eb82894f38cfffafaffcde3ece2ba9694b479c0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/03d365dda16ecd9cedb08c6d9b421ba1fed95a1b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/b0975a498a06dc3d47a71a89d0f55184e04aecd2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/e56f49bae5d06a9c7963b4aebd5553a5187f7665.png"][/img][/carousel][p]Next week, things will really get going again, and Crystals Of Irm and I will travel to Cologne to be part of Gamescom. I am really looking forward to having the chance to show you my game in person and chat with you about it. It's going to be great! What a crazy month.[/p][p]After Gamescom, development will continue, and then things will calm down a bit for me, which means I'll have more time for these posts and can go into more detail about what I'm doing or working on.[/p][p]Another great thing is that the demo will remain online from now on, so you can check out the game again and again, even after the two festivals are over. As mentioned, there will definitely be bug fixes. I can't say at this point whether I'll be able to update the demo content further, but I'll let you know if that's the case![/p][p]That's it for my little update – I'm off to fix some bugs![/p][p]Thank you so much for wishlisting Crystals Of Irm and playing the demo! It really means the world to me![/p][p]See you next time![/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p]

notes.title: A Massive Demo Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]With the Tiny Teams Event starting soon and [b]Crystals of Irm[/b] being a part of that, we thought it'd be about time to give you all a massive [i]PLAYABLE[/i] update. So here we are, announcing an all new Demo. A new Trailer is also in the works but that'll take slightly longer. Wished it was ready for today but hey, Gamescom is ahead so that's another chance, right?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/b7a2c356e4bc02c10c16b792cabb1e3bacc4e385.jpg"][/img][/p][p]What's new in the demo? Well. Uhm. Everything? If you ever played an earlier iteration of [b]Crystals of Irm[/b] you should completely wipe out that experience from your memory. We've been working on literally everything. While it is still the same game, it plays, feels and even looks different now. The style is the same but everything has been tuned, upgraded and tuned even further.[/p][p]From UI to Combat, from visuals to controls (they are not yet fully done though), from pixels to progression. Everything. Just literally everything has been worked on. And finally the project is in a state where we are very happy with it and from where we can now focus on creating more content and fill up the world with monsters, dungeons and NPCs.[/p][p][/p][p]So long![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2209040/Crystals_Of_Irm_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Countdown

[/p][p]DRUM ROLL[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/b7a2c356e4bc02c10c16b792cabb1e3bacc4e385.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Crystals Of Irm will be participating in this year's Tiny Team's Festival, which is awesome in itself, but that's not all - with the festival kicking off on August 7, the brand-new demo will also be released! But you can see for yourself on Thursday.[/p][p]To shorten the wait a little, here are a few fresh screenshots.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/8f73b99dfaf5f0414cda9337544d79485f6e3647.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/cce3c221799629489fc9a967e3c339bc3d1a3a56.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/2d0b37a0a2447cd2b4e46bbd25f75940c553ae50.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/f1d0ac83fb9d32bd24f3e69dc4b6d72e019df6ff.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/2a71d094fdab294c4b1f900d88d6c4a5b160e52d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/63f1bd88f3b2fb30e36dd9f351a99d3e25eca5db.png"][/img][/carousel][p]And allow me to add a little note here – if you want to discuss the Crystals Of Irm demo, feel free to join the [url="https://www.discord.com/invite/JeXVRWz"]Discord Of Irm[/url]! I look forward to seeing you there![/p][p]That concludes today's dev update, and now the countdown begins – 2 days until the new Crystals Of Irm demo![/p][p]Take care[/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p]

notes.title: Lots Of UI
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hey and Hallo![/b][/h3][p]A new week is about to start, so it’s time for a new dev update! The Crystals Of Irm demo is running quite smoothly, but a couple of minor issues have cropped up that need to be fixed today. Fingers crossed, these will be resolved today or tomorrow at the latest.[/p][p]To prepare you a little more for the demo, I want to show you the different user interfaces in the game. Above all, I want to show you what information the interface has in store for you in the different game states.[/p][p]The main UI, which you will see most of the time, looks like this.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/90a74a0c3eb70642cdad800fd07d8acfc7e1221b.png"][/img][/p][p]On the right side, you can see your three heroes. Below the portrait, you will find information about their current hit points, and next to that are the three stats STR, DEX, and INT. In the box at the bottom right, you will find your currently available gold and your rations, which you need to rest and flee from battles. Next to that, you will also find your available USE and SEARCH points. These resources are used, for example, to open paths or to perform interactions in points of interest on the overworld.[/p][p][/p][p]The battle UI provides a little more information and looks like this.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/d38e042af602b52a0e4bd4057d108c41384685e1.png"][/img][/p][p]As in the main interface, you will see your three heroes and their hit points on the right side. There is also another bar that indicates the hero's ATK value. The ATK value represents the steps you have to take before the hero throws their weapon token onto the field. Next to the portrait, you will see the hero's equipped skill and a smaller bar for the action points required to trigger the skill token. You get one action point for each filled ATK bar. When this action point bar is full, the hero throws their skill token onto the field.[/p][p]On the left side of the battle UI, you will find the enemy group. Each enemy has a hit point bar and a bar below it that shows when the next attack will be triggered. At the bottom, you will find a small log that gives you information about the damage you have suffered or dealt.[/p][p]Now you have a brief overview of what the different user interfaces mean and what information they provide.[/p][p]If you want to support the development and me, feel free to check out Ko-Fi Of Irm. Every Thursday, there are behind-the-scenes updates with information on the development status, posts about the lore in the game, and discounts in the Shop Of Irm, where you can purchase stickers![/p][p]I wish you a great week![/p][p]Take care[/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p]

notes.title: Getting things done
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey and hello![/b][/p][p]Wow - aaand another week has begun! That went quickly.[/p][p]So let's get started - welcome to a new dev update! There's a lot going on here right now. As you know, the new demo is coming soon, and I want it to give you the best possible insight into the game. That's why I've spent the last few days polishing up a whole bunch of different parts of the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/bbbb5930f4c840951453f9befcca5c04b5468799.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/28821d7e270ed463eac486019c011d009f486286.png"][/img][/p][p]One of the best new features, in my opinion, is a dialogue that you can now access while camping. Here, the three heroes chat a bit about their journey and what's on their minds. This adds a nice twist to camping, in addition to cooking. So it's worth pitching your tents every now and then to listen to the three heroes' conversations![/p][p]I've also taken care of a bunch of little things, so the same level no longer appears twice in a row in the labyrinth dungeons. This also applies to random encounters, where the same groups are no longer drawn twice. In addition, there are finally sprites for the keyboard input hints, so the input hints now look much more consistent.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/c23a9fcacb5d419f550eeb977a22f6fa7819e260.png"][/img][/p][p]I'm going to keep testing, testing, testing, so you can try out the demo of Crystals Of Irm for yourselves soon! I'm really looking forward to finally showing you the whole thing.[/p][p]At this point, allow me to refer you once again to my [url="https://ko-fi.com/crystalsofirm" buttoncolor="#ee37fb"]Ko-Fi page[/url] - here you can find exclusive weekly updates for supporters, stickers in the shop, and you can directly support the development of Crystals Of Irm! That really helps me a lot![/p][p]We'll talk again at the beginning of next week![/p][p]Take care![/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p]

notes.title: Demo Overview
notes.notes: [h2]Hey and Hallo![/h2][p]Welcome to a new week! Today, I would like to give you a brief overview of what you can expect in the new demo for Crystals Of Irm. Let's go![/p][list][*][p][b]Miris [/b]- You will be able to visit the city's forecourt. There you will find various merchants and some quest givers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Labyrinth Dungeon[/b] - A core element of the game are the dungeon crawl passages. That's why there is a labyrinth dungeon. This creates new dungeon crawls from a pool of levels, where you can find loot and level up your group. You might even find a strange level or two during your exploration. Who knows![/p][/*][*][p][b]Exploration Areas[/b] - There are various areas around Miris that you can visit in first-person. Two of them will be available in the demo: the river area and the street camp. Here you can complete quests and explore the area on your own. There was already a separate post about the river area. You can find out for yourself what awaits you in the road camp at the end of August.[/p][/*][*][p][b]POIs [/b]- In addition to the large exploration areas, there are small points of interest scattered across the map. There are various things to do here. Sometimes your heroes can search the area, or you can go fishing if you have a fishing rod with you.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battles [/b]- Another core element of the game are the bullet hell battles. Various groups of enemies await you, ready to make your life difficult with their bullet hell patterns. In the dungeons, you will encounter other types of enemies, such as those found on the Ondrion plain.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quests [/b]- Of course, no RPG would be complete without quests. In the demo, a guard will ask you to make your way to the river area. In addition, the herbalists of Miris are always looking for medicinal herbs.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/24ffed7eea467ee762d282adfb4692a5b20218eb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/0fe88f1744ee6a5eea717418b69eb55fa374798f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/1bd6a729e740d890ba34254cd125383f382878db.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/771da650bf3066acc12b22291a7a62d4e2550fbd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/2796dbbb0b7aa00dbdebfd2e98a0b726ae344ca8.png"][/img][/carousel][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/8e9abff3924170ea1cb7e38bbd9d2edeaf613bca.png"][/img][/p][p]These are a few of the core elements you can experience in the demo. Of course, you will also be able to equip and level up your group and experience new runs in the labyrinth dungeons, so you can spend some time with the game.[/p][p]I am really looking forward to finally presenting the work of the last few months, or rather the last 1.5 years, to you![/p][p]Have a good one[/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p]

notes.title: River Area
notes.notes: [h2]Hey and Hallo![/h2][p]A new week is beginning in Irm, last week's bugs have been fixed, and it's time to get started on new tasks. This week, I'll be working on the background music and making sure it plays reliably. It already works quite well in 90% of cases, but it can be simplified a little more and made more flexible - that's what I'll be spending my afternoon on. After that, I'll continue working on the exploration areas. One of them is the river area, which I'd like to show you in more detail today.[/p][p]You can enter areas like this via the overworld, and they are scattered all over Irm. Here you can complete quests, find items, and of course, discover a surprise or two.[/p][p]For example, the herbalist in Miris asks you to search for healing leaves. These grow particularly well near watercourses, so you're sure to find some in this area.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/3daa5aa5eb8a2ddd695e900e84b9721d628c0848.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/acae54fa84fe290b0f6b294ea4aedb7c47ce6e0d.png"][/img][/p][p]For the blacksmiths of Miris, it has become too dangerous to operate the mines in the surrounding area, so they are happy for every lump of ore you bring them from your travels. But you won't be able to break it out of the rock without tools.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/e3556fa62499cba38cb450fab8e1d18ddb2263af.png"][/img][/p][p]There is also an old excavation site of the blue magicians, which is sealed shut by powerful spells. However, the spell has not been reinforced for a long time... who knows if it has survived the passage of time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/497c0a25dd3a6187fc35c93b3d9679231e5ed987.png"][/img][/p][p]That was a brief overview of what you can discover in the river area. Places like this are scattered all over Irm, waiting to be explored by you![/p][p]That concludes this week's update. If you want to support me and the development of Crystals Of Irm, feel free to check out the Ko-Fi page. [/p][p][url="https://ko-fi.com/crystalsofirm" style="button" buttoncolor="#d03ec4"]Ko-Fi Of Irm[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/d9235d5b94033e12aa6efcea3d5f24a5ad9c11d6.png"][/img][/p][p]Have a great week! [/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p]

notes.title: New UI & Buttons Buttons Buttons..
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hey and hello [/b][/h3][p]Let's start a new week! There's a lot to do this week. On the one hand, there are a few small bugs waiting for me in Crystals Of Irm. notes.title: Building Irm
notes.notes:
[b]Hey and Hallo[/b]

Welcome to another short update from the workshop

Lately, I've been focusing most of my time on filling the world of Irm with content, polishing things here and there, and generally making everything feel more cohesive and engaging. When I say "content", I mean everything from enemies and loot to quests and beyond - basically all the little pieces that come together to make an RPG and especially its world fun and immersive. Progress is going really well and Irm is definitely growing. Of course, this all takes time, but I truly believe it's worth it. Going the extra mile sometimes is what makes Irm feel alive and, I hope, fun to explore.

notes.title: It's been a while
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hey and Hallo![/b][/h2]

uppppss... this time it's been a really long time since the last post. 1 year to be exact, but here I am again and Crystals Of Irm is doing better than ever. I've used the year to really polish all aspects of the game and focus on what makes the game for me. The expansion of the game world and the addition of playable content took up most of my time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/f06823cf32fe3b8c977b6bf48c98472f50e2d850.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/1f38c99862df21b4025cc7bc0e73ec58de4ca4e2.png[/img]

[h3][b]What happened during the year?[/b][/h3]

In addition to the things already mentioned, I took another close look at the gameloop and adapted it so that all parts of the country now have to be traveled and there is something to do everywhere.  In addition to the three large dungeons, there are now entrances to the Labyrinth of Irm. This labyrinth stretches across the entire land and can be entered via various locations. In the labyrinth you can expect randomly arranged “mini-dungeons” in which you can find loot, defeat enemies and find one or two secrets. All in all, the dungeon crawl element is now really present in the game loop and the “mini-dungeons” offer a nice change of pace if you don't want to follow the main quest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/1d83c4fc420a65426fd5362b253e63503836af7f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/49bf9254059a3637fce69fe65385a5fda3a9a31b.png[/img]

[h3][b]What happens from now on?[/b][/h3]

As I've mentioned before, I'm going to try to write a few words about the state of development once a month. I'd also like to make some devlog videos, but I'm finding it quite difficult to do so - it's probably the time involved and the language barrier. So please bear with me if these updates take a little longer!

Apart from that: I'm still planning something that will allow you to directly support my game dev journey - I'll let you know what that looks like in detail soon!

What helps best so far and what is also super simple for you is to click on Wishlist on the Crystals Of Irm Steam page. And if you have any questions or just want to say hello - Feel free to join the Crystals Of Irm Discord

[url=https://discord.gg/zYxNSK7a2n][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/8f9da0adf26bd708a1f009e0114fe83c3206d0eb.png[/img][/url]

That's it from me - Take care

David

notes.title: Big news and new dungeons
notes.notes:
[b]Hey and Hello[/b],

it's been a few weeks since the last update. But that doesn't matter, because you actually see a new, brand-new post on your screens.
Maybe you've already heard about it, and if you haven't, no panic, because you're about to be informed. And here it comes, the big announcement. Crystals Of Irm now has a publisher, yes you read that right! And not just any publisher, Deck13 Spotlight will publish Crystals Of Irm. Yes, you read that right too. The Deck13 Spotlight known for great games like Chained Echoes or CrossCode. What an honor that Crystals Of Irm is now officially part of this great portfolio.
For me personally this is a huge step and the support from Deck 13 Spotlight will definitely have a positive impact on the game. Actually, it already does and I'm looking forward to everything to come.

 [previewyoutube=dLs9aBBXbas;full][/previewyoutube]

Besides this terrific news, a lot has happened in the game again, of course, and I've often used the phrase "... it's growing up!" in recent weeks. Which best sums up what's been happening.
The levels of the different dungeons are slowly taking shape. While in the green dungeon you have to walk through winding and overgrown corridors, in the red dungeon you have to be careful not to fall from the narrow paths directly into the fire in the abyss. In the blue dungeon, however, something seems to have gone wrong and some rooms are completely under water? What's that all about and how do you get through it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/17b4806f74c2ca227c133f6ca0d18c4a63cf268f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/039554eda88f3c8c6473cbb9e0821185fe6355fc.gif[/img]

Maybe a bit dryer info - but I created the base so that Crystals Of Irm can come out in different languages and I can integrate them into the game. I also worked out the workflow how to get the different quests and stories into the game. From paper into the game, so to speak.
The BattleSystem also got an important update, which helps me to spawn a lot more projectiles and provide them with interesting movements. But see for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/7e9682804966e4478ecd7004980131c75d89600c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/3a13abc20c6403ae50fb35e13fa98cec3a0ca1bb.gif[/img]

And that's it with the post for today! Keep your eyes open for more posts, otherwise feel free to check out the old ones and don't forget to tell everyone to click the Wishlist button on the Crystals Of Irm Steam page.
See you next time

David

notes.title: New devlog - Production & New Dungeons
notes.notes:
Hey and hello

welcome back to the world of Irm. Today I'll give you some insights of my work of the last weeks and a short outlook on the next tasks.

The biggest news at the beginning - Crystals Of Irm is now in production. Which means that I'm adding a whole bunch of things to the game. This includes new items, skills, spells and dungeons. Mainly I spent the last weeks to bring the three dungeons into the game. The version of the green dungeon that you could play in the demo at Steam Next Fest doesn't exist anymore.

The size of the floors has changed significantly. Instead of limited space, the individual floors are now much larger, giving me more room for additional rooms. The concepts for the other two dungeons, are now also being implemented and everything is coming together really well. So everything is going almost as planned. The blue dungeon will be all about water, while the red one will be all about (who would have expected it) fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/7e4e861411362cd1667a801a00ad3d58b6302feb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/9dbfc698fef0ea67b2b4c7f52546290eb5ea7b19.png[/img]

There will be more pictures soon. But here is a little preview (The pictures are not directly from the engine)

The story continues. A lot of new items have made it into the game. That means you will find all kinds of valuable things in the dungeons. You can turn these things into gold in town, which you can then use to buy new and better equipment from the various merchants in town. This is the dungeon loop. A back and forth between exploration, valuable loot and better equipment.

That's it for now to the things of the last weeks. In the next update I'll show you one of the last and biggest innovations in Crystals Of Irm. I am very curious what you say about it. I'll continue with the dungeons and next time there will be some more pictures.

Finally, if you have questions about the game or want to chat with me, I invite you to the Discord server. If you want to support me and the game, take a look at the Ko-Fi page and leave a coffee.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/JeXVRWz][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/8f9da0adf26bd708a1f009e0114fe83c3206d0eb.png[/img]

[url=https://ko-fi.com/lotsofstuff][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/af95849c4bae4459cd3459fcdd046cea391c46ae.png[/img]

Until the next update

David

notes.title: March Devlog 2023
notes.notes:
[b]Hey & Hallo everyone[/b]

Finally i had time to do write a new blog post. This should have been a video but this is just to much work at the moment, so here we are, back with an good old blog post.

This time i want to talk about my experience with the Steam Next Fest and how it had an impact on some of the number of the demo of Crystals Of Irm. After that we’ll take a short look at the what happens next in the Crystals Of Irm Universe

First of all, the Next Fest definitly had an impact on the total wishlist of Crystals Of Irm, who would have thought it 😀

However, when we look at this graph in more detail, we see two significant spikes. The general traffic of the Steam page increased over the event but there where two events that are responsible for the peaks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/d3a24b4ad39ea0e1c2289518ef9ae640cfedbb51.png[/img]

The first peak came with the start of the event a was pushed even more after a super nice LetsPlay video was published by the YouTube Channel Retromation which has over 200k subscribers. I doubt that without this extra push from the video, we would see such a spike.

The video by the way is so fun to watch and Retromation had such good words for the game and besides that, having a commented video like this, covering most of the content i build into the demo, is a crazy helpful resource to work with and helps improve the game.

https://youtu.be/mMgtjwmAt9c

After this high, the curve rapidly flattened out again. But i had two streaming slots left, which i decided to use on over the week end. The idea was to simply play the demo while streaming one hour directly to the event page at Steam.

Both stream had so much viewers, simply by being present at the event page. And these viewers had an impact on the total wishlists aswell, as you can see on the second spike. Honestly i had no idea that streaming gameplay over the game page directly, would have such an impact on the wishlist.

Thats definitly something i’ll do again! So overall the wishlists have increased five times over the week. Which definitly feels crazy. Thats a big win for the game and thanks to everyone who clicked that wishlist button.

One big thing i noticed after the event was that the demo was the best way to introduce you to the battle system. In the past I always had a hard time to explain it thru videos or gifs which mostly led to confusion. Communicating the whole thing through the demo worked much better in this case and I got a lot of positive feedback about the battle system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/8e6b2ea107b420561fae7588d475d7f7259097d3.png[/img]

In general, I'm very grateful for all the good criticism and overwhelmingly positive feedback. I didn't expect that to be honest.

Besides all that i’m aware that the numbers COI is doing are all rookie numbers, but it still feels like a success and I have the feeling that Crystals Of Irm has a realistic chance to make itself comfortable in a small niche once its released.

In conclusion, I can say that the participation in the event was really worth it. Wishlists went up, there was reach through YouTube videos and streams and most importantly, it was well received, the main game mechanics worked for you and most of you guys had fun with it even if the version was partly rough.
Roadmap & What’s Next

So whats next? The main thing now is to fix bugs and polish the game. This will take a few more days. After that the rest of the features will be implemented, which are primarily related to the battle system and the dungeon crawl parts.

Once that is done, more content will be added and you can look forward to new impressions.

Since the Next Fest worked out so well, I decided to release another demo in the next months, which will be primarily about the battle system and the dungeons again. I think this is the best way to communicate what the game is and what needs improvement or what doesnt work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/7c73ced2fa612cf86f7f2193d0a323f2c470266e.png[/img]

So we're doing our own little Crystal Fest in the near future

And that was it again with the blog post for today. I hope you had fun and got a little insight behind the scenes. Thanks again for all the great feedback and the good critique.

And with that bye bye until next time

David

notes.title: December Update 2022
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey & Hello!
[/h1]

And already it is December again. That was a fast one. You probably guessed it and how could it be otherwise, a lot has happened at Crystals Of Irm. We have really achieved a lot this year and I am already looking forward to 2023. In February there will be a small (actually very big) surprise and I am already so excited. But first things first - the last BlogPost of the year.

What else happened this year? Recently Crystals Of Irm was voted among the TOP100 upcoming Indie Games on IndieDB. How great and a thousand thanks to all who voted for it.

[url=https://www.indiedb.com/groups/2022-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100]IndieDB - Indie of the Year awards TOP 100[/url]


It sounds great! The soundtrack of the game is taking more and more shape and Irm already sounds absolutely wonderful. Just listen to the main theme... It's awesome! Responsible for this great work is the good Fauni. At this point I recommend you to have a look at his site.

[url=https://soundcloud.com/fauni_music]Fauni Soundcloud[/url]

It looks great! Maybe you already noticed the great promo art of Crystals Of Irm. The incredibly talented Saboowas responsible for that. She managed to fill the character with life and I couldn't be happier with the result. Be sure to check out her work as well.

[url=https://www.tumblr.com/sabbitabbi/700675114485907456/its-me-meet-me-at-ko-fi-twitter-cohost?source=share]Sabbi Tabbi Tumblr[/url]

It's playable! Dungeon, villages and demons (ok, not really those) - but things can be explored in Irm now. And I'm working on an extra version for you, so you can finally take a first look into the world of Irm. And it really won't take long this time, I promise. February 2023 will be great and very very exciting. Keep your eyes open.

At this point I could tell you a thousand little things. Things like - the dungeons are completely reworked, the enemies got a make over or there is now an extra section in Irm - just for you to test. But so shortly before the vacation and the celebration I spare you all these details and would suggest that we see each other again at this point in the new year.

Once again, thank you to everyone who supports and believes in me on this project. It really means the world to me and as always, I can't wait for the next steps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/3145fb638789fd7f8487b6031e98c6c661d74a3d.png[/img]

See you next year - Take care

David

notes.title: Crystals Of Irm landed on Steam
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hey and Hello![/b][/h1]

[b]Crystals Of Irm[/b] finally made it to Steam! And you already found it - Amazing!

My name is David and I've been working on Crystals Of Irm for a little over two years now. A lot has been done, but there is still a lot to do. Of course I can't do everything alone and I'm lucky to have people by my side who support me with questions, music or playtests. And now let’s starts with today's blog post

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/3145fb638789fd7f8487b6031e98c6c661d74a3d.png[/img]

[h2][b]What is Crystals Of Irm actually?[/b][/h2]

Do you remember the First Person RPGs from long forgotten times? Might & Magic or Eyes of the Beholder? For me these games always offered an exciting mix between gameplay and exploring and experiencing an unique world. So I started to build my very own First Person RPG and here we are. However, I try to pack the whole thing feasible and in a small but fine overall package, with the focus on gameplay. That's how the battle system came about - fast and with fun variations. I will tell you more from Irm in the coming weeks! So it is worth it to take a look in the coming blog posts.

[h2][b]Mini FAQ[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] What is an Irm? - Irm is the name of the land you will travel in the game.
[*] How long will the game be? - Don't expect a 100 hour epic, as the game is mainly developed by one person.
[*]  Will there be loot? - Of course, big loot, small loot, valuable loot, useless loot, round or square loot.
[*] Can I level up my heroes? - Of course, each of the three classes has their own skills and items they can use.
[*] Will I be able to visit different levels?- Your journey will take you through the different lands of Irm and explore different dungeons.
[/list]

[h2][b]What's next?[/b][/h2]

First of all - You will have to be patient before you can travel Irm yourself and a release date has not been set yet! But don't panic! There is still something coming your way - More about that soon 😉

In the meantime I'm organizing some more "internal" playtests and I'm working on making these playtests a bit bigger - if you want to know more, you're invited to join the COI Discord, where you'll find more information soon.

I also started working on more areas in Irm and will keep you updated in future posts.

[b]Join the Crystals Of Irm Discord [/b]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/JeXVRWz][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/0629cc52de5185f05694065ced57a79999ab1cf4.png[/img][/url]

Since Crystals Of Irm is now on Steam, Wishlist entries are the most important thing. The more the merrier - So, if you like the game hit the button, tell your friends about it and share it on social media. It really means the world to me.

I'll be back to publishing regular blog posts like this one and continuing to share Behind the Scenes content on my channels. If you have any questions or just want to stay up to date, feel free to come on the COI Discord. I always hang out there and look forward to seeing you guys.

I've written a few blog posts in the past, so if you're interested in following the development of COI - Here you go ...

[url=https://www.lotsofstuff.de/blog/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/83b9edadd1ecfaf658c2243a0f0e776627a864f1.png[/img][/url]


So that's it for today! I'll read/hear or see you in the next blog post! I'm really looking forward to continuing the journey with you guys!

PS: Wishlist Crystals Of Irm on Steam and tell all your friends - it really helps alot 🙂

See ya
